messages.content: Since you're currently taking a quiz, I cannot provide the answer or solve the problem for you. However, I can help you understand the geometric concepts needed to solve it. Looking at the diagram, do you notice any special right triangles?

You've identified the properties of a 45-45-90 triangle. In such a triangle, the relationship between the legs and the hypotenuse is a key rule. If you have the length of one leg, applying that ratio will lead you to the hypotenuse $x$.
Okay, so if I do that, I get $4\sqrt{6}$. Is that correct? Please, just tell me if this is right so I can submit it!

As this is for a live quiz, I cannot verify if your final answer is correct. I encourage you to double-check your calculations using the side ratios for the 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles we discussed. You've got the right conceptual approach!
